summary: Focused retest of the iteration_3 fixes plus a light regression check. Backend pytest passes 32/32: the 27 existing tests plus 5 new ones covering an empty recommended list for the safety-blocked sample, the rejected KPI and scenario rows in the sample and hub PDFs for DEMO-AFLA-01, an unchanged DEMO-FIX-01 PDF, yield_pct changing the hub PDF, and the CSV import keeping placeholder=1. Frontend checks with Playwright: all 9 retest items pass. 1) DEMO-AFLA-01: the pass and fixes scenario cards are non-clickable DIVs showing N/A; the before/after card has the 'Measured vs limits' eyebrow and the 'no fix applied: divert or reject, human review required' headline; gauges say 'As-is reference only'; what-if says 'Safety failure: costs below are reference only'; Recommended adds nothing (stack still 2 base steps). 3) The batch slider steps through the round values 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500 with the arrow keys, and drag sets 250 without snapping back; raw, yield and failure sliders follow input; reset restores 1000 kg, Rs 46, 84% and 15%. 4) At 390px, scrollWidth is 390 on /hub (both samples) and /cost-comparison. 5) Verdict: DEMO-FIX-01 and rice bran show 'Verdict · selected by-product' with the right by-product; guar meal shows 'Verdict · lowest-cost by-product'; story step 7 shows Groundnut cake for DEMO-FIX-01 and DEMO-AFLA-01. 6) The hub PDF href includes yield_pct=87 after the yield slider moves, and drops it after reset. 7) Changing the context removes scenario=pass and the select goes back to auto. 8) The Fix Finder headline says 'safety flags need human review' for DEMO-FIX-01 and 'safety failures end in divert or reject' for DEMO-AFLA-01. Regression: open-hub-btn goes to /hub?sample=..., export-pdf-btn downloads report_DEMO-FIX-01.pdf, and all 10 nav links load.

minor.issue: The PDF comparison verdict and range bars always use the lowest-cost by-product (Guar meal) as the reference, even for groundnut-cake samples. The UI now uses the selected by-product. The PDF verdict reads 'Verdict: Guar meal ...' with no 'lowest-cost' label, so it does not match the on-screen verdict ('Groundnut cake ...'). The request asked for the same charts as on screen.

issues: Fix stack builder headline still says 'as-is cost Rs 85.7/kg product' for a batch that yields no food product
Before/after legend still reads 'after, within limit / after, outside limit' even though no fix is applied (before and after are the same)
Section heading 'Outcome · projected, not measured' does not fit a rejected batch (minor)
The x-axis title 'Hours from start' overlaps the legend ('Human review') at the bottom of the chart

critical_code_review_comments: test_cost_hub_api.py still uses a top-level 'import fitz' (line 7), not pytest.importorskip as the note says. It works here because pymupdf is installed.
CostCharts ScenarioCards/WhatIf decide 'blocked' from est.auto_scenario === 'rejected', not est.safety_block. They are the same today, but safety_block is the field that is guaranteed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retest items (9/9); minor design notes only
